selection_note: The authority-aligned R256 selector still preferred a pathological foam state because FAILED_PER_VIEW_RULE_COUNT dominated normalized severity; this is an apparatus lesson, not a valid quality preference.

resolution_interpretation.conclusion: Increasing extraction resolution densified the same pathological zero-set instead of converging toward the source silhouette. Extraction resolution is not the current owner.

foam_diagnosis.mechanism: Saturating foreground ray existence plus discretely sampled background positivity admits highly oscillatory zero sets between supervised samples when field regularity is only local. Narrow-band Eikonal covered at most 512 FIT-local points within |teacher_sdf|<=0.02 and did not constrain the full canonical volume.
foam_diagnosis.important_correction: Finite-sample Eikonal is a regularizer, not an exact global 1-Lipschitz proof. The next arm therefore adds both global Eikonal sampling and an explicit adjacent-ray-sample Lipschitz excess penalty.
foam_diagnosis.reason: A 2D source ray may legitimately intersect multiple depth layers; exact crossing multiplicity would invent unsupported 3D truth. Crossing counts remain diagnostic only.

next_treatment.raster_escalation_trigger: If source-only global regularity closes foam but exact Stage13 contour still materially fails, authorize raster-coupled extracted-surface supervision next.

compute_postmortem.problem: Exact Stage13 was scheduled on multi-million-face pathological meshes and produced multi-hour silent CPU work.
compute_postmortem.repair: Keep Stage13 unchanged but put an apparatus-only compute scheduler in front of it: cheap R128 complexity screening, progress heartbeat, bounded face-count scheduling, R256 promotion screen, and R512 only after R256 remains promotion-viable.
